summary: A citizen reporting platform API supporting user registration, verification, login, and logout. Citizens can create reports with images, view categories, and update their profiles. Municipality officers are created by admins and assigned roles. Tech leads assign officers to reports and manage agents. The system includes chat messaging for specific report contexts, notifications management, and public endpoints for viewing accepted reports and static image serving.

authentication_notes: /register and /verify are public endpoints for initial account setup
/login establishes session state required for all authenticated operations
/users/uploads/{filename} is the only endpoint that does not require authentication
Operations marked auth_required need an authenticated session during test setup.
dependencies: POST /register must precede POST /verify to complete account creation flow
POST /login must precede all authenticated operations including profile updates, report creation, and admin functions
POST /admin/accounts/register must precede PUT /admin/accounts/assign to create officer before assigning roles
POST /users/reports must precede GET /messages/{reportId}/officer-user or GET /messages/{reportId}/lead-external as reports must exist for chat context
PUT /tech-lead/report/{reportId} creates assignment state required for GET /tech/reports/list
POST /register -> POST /verify: Verification code is generated during registration and consumed in verification step
POST /login -> PUT /users/me: Profile update requires active authenticated session
POST /login -> POST /users/reports: Report creation requires authenticated user identity
POST /admin/accounts/register -> PUT /admin/accounts/assign: Role assignment requires existing officer account created via register
POST /users/reports -> PUT /tech-lead/report/{reportId}: Tech lead assignment requires existing report resource
POST /users/reports -> GET /messages/{reportId}/officer-user: Chat messages require existing report context
POST /users/reports -> GET /messages/{reportId}/lead-external: Chat messages require existing report context
PUT /tech-lead/report/{reportId} -> GET /tech/reports/list: Tech agent report list depends on assignment state created by tech lead
GET /notifications -> DELETE /notifications/{id}: Notification deletion requires existing notification resource
GET /notifications -> PATCH /notifications/{id}/read: Marking as read requires existing notification state

risks: POST /register does not specify if verification code is sent via email or SMS, creating ambiguity in client implementation
POST /verify lacks explicit error codes for invalid code vs expired code beyond generic 400
PUT /reports/{id}/status has no documented response codes other than 200 and 400, missing success confirmation details
GET /users/{username}/my-reports requires username but does not specify if it must match authenticated user or can be any user
POST /messages/{chatId} lacks documentation on how chatId is derived or validated
PUT /admin/accounts/assign includes nullable companyName in properties but not in required fields, creating potential inconsistency
GET /reports/list/accepted returns 500 error code without specific message, hindering debugging
